title: Move Transport row from gh/mod.rs to gh/transport.rs (G2 retry)
summary: Retry of structure-pass job G2: move the Transport items verbatim into gh/transport.rs, re-export them from gh/mod.rs so public paths are unchanged, and add a CHANGELOG entry. Criteria rest only on what the verifier can run itself (Grep, cargo test --list), not on the producer's report.

defaults_applied.how: cargo test, clippy and fmt criteria.
Criteria run Grep and test list comparison.
One focused move in three files.
The check is that paths and tests are unchanged.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Audience is the verifier applying section 5 of docs/design/structure-pass.md.
Adding use lines to test modules is allowed as import edits.
The handover-check work in the introspection's proposal is out of scope; the user's request is only to retry G2.

acceptance_criteria.text: gh/transport.rs holds the Transport row items (Runner, GhCli, GhFailure, parse_status, is_transient, transient_text, Retry, retry_transient, clock_entropy, HttpReply, HttpPost, CurlHttp, HostErrorLog) with the same text as before; git diff shows only moved lines plus mod/re-export lines.
gh/mod.rs declares `mod transport;` and re-exports each moved item that had an external path. Test modules differ only in `use` lines.

No file outside crates/athena-core/src/gh/ names a moved item by a path that stops resolving: a Grep of crates/ for `gh::transport::` finds no hits outside gh/, and every `gh::<moved name>` hit outside gh/ still resolves because cargo check passes with no caller file changed. The verifier runs the Grep itself.

Run `cargo test --locked -- --list` and compare the test names with the base (git stash-free: compare against output at base via git show); the list is identical. Run `cargo test --locked`; it passes.
Run `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`; both are clean.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the move; only gh/mod.rs, gh/transport.rs and CHANGELOG.md change, with no config, workflow or other docs changes.

out_of_scope: Any behavior change to the moved code
